svg.title: Failover drill: when one site goes dark, its traffic moves to the next nearest site
svg.desc: North America as dots with PolarGrid's eight live sites. Lines run from cities to their nearest site. In a drill that loops, one site at a time goes dark, its lines swing to the next nearest site, and the endpoint stays up; then it comes back. The status line reads: drill, one site down, its traffic moved to the next nearest, endpoint up.

g.text: DRILL · ONE SITE DOWN · ITS TRAFFIC MOVED TO THE NEXT NEAREST · ENDPOINT UP
